name: Gau Rugeila
source: The personal assassin of [url=/c547]Gilbert[/url], and one of the most dangerous people in the city. [spoiler]Forged by her traumatic childhood in the Prison, while she is nominally under Gilbert's reins, her only goal in life is to fight to satisfy her bloodlust.[/spoiler]
